title: Mucha in Iowa
content: Blog reader Amber Wallin recommends the museum exhibitionAlphonse Mucha: Inspirations of Art Nouveauat the National Czech & Slovak Museum & Library in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. She said it was worth the six hour drive from St. Paul, Minnesota.She says, "I hadn't realized how large a format his litho prints were, and that--of course--reproductions of his work don't begin to accurately convey his palette! The man apparently frequently used metallic inks that are brilliant in person but turn flat and dull when reprinted.  They also feature dozens of his family and model photographs pulled from glass negatives.  Given the limitations of photography compared to today's, he was just as talented a photographer as he was a painter!"The show is up until the end of December.Thanks, Amber.
